note: Where a pot's money can be kept. Ids match the investment types (plus plain cash); the names and one-line guidance are in the app's language files. `emergencyFit` says how well each suits an emergency fund: good = easy to reach and keeps its value, ok = reachable but its price swings or it loses value over time, risky = can swing a lot or be hard to sell fast. A rule of thumb of ours, not advice.
